title: GUDECA Europe meets at the Fon's Palace in Bonn
excerpt: The European chapter of the Guneku Development and Cultural Association met on 28 March 2026 at the Fon's Palace in Bonn, Germany. Members reviewed Solar Electrification Phase II, the Guneku CIG, and proposals for a medical unit, soap production and digital empowerment.
sourceNote: Written from the official Minutes of the GUDECA EU Meeting, Bonn, 28 March 2026, supplied by Marcel. Proposals are recorded as proposals. Nothing here is presented as delivered.
body:
The European chapter of the Guneku Development and Cultural Association (GUDECA EU) held its meeting on Saturday, 28 March 2026 at 2 p.m., at the Fon's Palace in Bonn, Germany.

The meeting reviewed work already under way in Guneku and considered several new proposals put to the chapter. What follows is drawn from the official minutes.

Solar Electrification Phase II

Phase II of the solar electrification work is ongoing. Contributions of €800 were reported to the meeting.

Guneku CIG

The Guneku Common Initiative Group was presented as a business-oriented development structure for the community. Poultry farming was proposed as its first project, and a share price of 2,000 FCFA per share was reported to the meeting.

Proposals put to the chapter

Three further initiatives were proposed. None has been delivered; each is recorded here at the stage it had reached at the meeting.

  • Medical unit — a reference healthcare centre in Guneku.
  • Soap production — an income-generating initiative for the community.
  • Education and digital empowerment — satellite internet at the Palace, adult training in content creation, digital and virtual work, and skills for earning online.

Next meeting

The next GUDECA Europe meeting is set for the United Kingdom on Saturday, 24 July 2027.
